title: Packages sheet: Adopt loose items uses the native confirm(), reports no count even when nothing moved, and the previous action's message lingers — a styled confirm, a count, and a clear per action (hotcrm#2194 R2-T2-U06)
body:
## 维护者速读

- **事由：** 软件包面板的「收编散项」用浏览器原生确认框，完成后只说「已收编」不给数量（下次发布发现 0 项），上一个动作的提示还留在下一个动作下面。
- **要做：** 样式化确认框；结果写明收编了几项；每次新动作清掉旧提示。
- **完成标准：** 管理员能看出到底收编了多少。

Filing gate **③ a task the maintainer set**: the maintainer's ruling on objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2194, recorded there at `6354968262` (the director seat, posting from the maintainer's account): 「25251 B hotcrm B」, 2026-10-23T01:05:47Z. That is letter B for all three rounds, exactly as the seat recommended, and it adopts **R2-T2-U06**. Filed by the `repo:hotcrm` seat 1 (`os-elon-musk`, session `session_014xanhPEmGTMTfVH4UokwJT`) under objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2194's *After the ruling*. ⛔ Not a claim.

**Grade:** triage's. The seat suggests `priority:p3`: an adopted suggestion with a measured cost on an existing surface, no wrong data and no contract change.

**Reader (who acts):** objectui triage routes and grades it. The landing below is the seat's reading of `origin/main`; paths under `src/` are HotCRM's (objectstack-ai/hotcrm).

## Governing text

- The ruling above. Per objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2194's own governing text, this item is an adopted suggestion through filing gate ②, not a defect card, and a platform or console landing is changed there, never re-implemented in HotCRM: 「平台相关的功能，应该尽量先改平台。」 (maintainer, 2026-10-18, ledger `6245607810`).

## Why (measured)

- **Page / persona:** Setup → Packages, a package's sheet, the system administrator.
- **Now (18.0.0):** Adopt loose items uses the browser's native `confirm()`, then says "Loose items adopted into this base." with no count, even when the next Publish finds 0 items. A previous action's message stays under the next (a Revert error stayed under Duplicate).
- **Cost:** the admin cannot tell whether anything moved.
- **Evidence:** objectstack-ai/hotcrm [round 2 track 2 report, *UI and UX suggestions*](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotcrm/blob/4d7cc467dcb08226fea5b8a1b2ea89ee05d6353b/qa/2026-10-20-v18-setup/REPORT.md), U-06; [`02-apps-packages-adopt-loose-items-result.png`](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotcrm/blob/4d7cc467dcb08226fea5b8a1b2ea89ee05d6353b/qa/2026-10-20-v18-setup/shots/02-apps-packages-adopt-loose-items-result.png), [`02-apps-packages-duplicate.png`](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotcrm/blob/4d7cc467dcb08226fea5b8a1b2ea89ee05d6353b/qa/2026-10-20-v18-setup/shots/02-apps-packages-duplicate.png).

## Landing

Read on objectui `origin/main` `74ebad09`:
- `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/PackagesPage.tsx` ~:806: `window.confirm(` for Adopt loose items. The count comes from the server's answer; if it carries none, that is an objectstack field to request, not a client count.

## Done when

- Adopt loose items asks in the styled confirm and reports "N items adopted" (0 included).
- Starting any sheet action clears the previous action's message.
- Tests on the three.

**Size:** S.

## Dedupe

Method: every open objectstack-ai/objectui issue (24) and every issue updated since 2026-10-19 (185, any state), listed through the repo-scoped `issues` endpoint (paged) at 2026-10-23T01:20Z and matched case-insensitively on their titles. Words: `adopt`, `loose items`, `packages sheet`. 1 hit: #13157 (closed, the read-only HotCRM sheet's actions), not on point. **New.**
